source.author: verg
source.text: Omnia fert aetas, animum quoque: saepe ego longos cantando puerum memini me condere soles:
source.text_original: Omnia fert aetas, animum quoque: saepe ego longos / cantando puerum memini me condere soles: /
source.text_english: Time carries off everything, even the mind: I often remember, as a boy, by singing, having passed the long hours until sunset.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: omnia fert aetas, animum quoque; saepe ego longos cantando puerum memini me condere soles.
reuse.text_original: omnia fert aetas, animum quoque; saepe ego longos cantando puerum memini me condere soles.
reuse.text_english: Time bears everything away, the mind too; often I remember that even as a boy I used to spend long evenings singing until sunset.
